internal.title: SEV1: Checkout Service Errors Due to Payment Service Flag Misconfiguration
internal.body:
At 11:36 UTC on 2026-11-08, we received alerts for a high error rate in the checkout service. Investigation identified a bad deploy related to the payment service, specifically the 'paymentFailure' flag being set to 50%, causing payment failures and knock-on errors in checkout. The error 'failed to charge card: Invalid token' appeared after this flag change.

The mitigation action was to disable the 'paymentFailure' flag at 11:56 UTC, which led to immediate recovery of the payment service error rate and resolution of checkout errors. The recovery was verified by monitoring the service error ratio dropping from 0.5 to 0.002 within minutes.

No further impact was observed after the flag was disabled. The incident was resolved promptly with coordinated approval and execution of the rollback.

Action items include reviewing deployment and flag management processes to prevent similar misconfigurations.

external.title: Some checkouts failed due to payment processing issues
external.body: Between 11:36 and 11:56 UTC on 2026-11-08, some customers experienced failures completing checkout due to issues in the payment processing system. The problem was identified and resolved by disabling a recent configuration change in the payment system. The service has since recovered and is operating normally. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.

output.summary: A configuration change in the payment service caused increased errors in checkout, impacting customer transactions. Disabling the problematic flag resolved the issue.
output.impact: Customers experienced failures completing checkout due to payment processing errors between 11:36 and 11:56 UTC.
output.root_cause: A bad deploy involving the 'paymentFailure' flag in the payment service caused invalid token errors and increased error rates in checkout.
output.resolution: The 'paymentFailure' flag was disabled at 11:56 UTC, leading to immediate recovery of the payment and checkout services.

lessons.lesson: Ensure thorough validation and staged rollout of feature flags to prevent widespread service impact from misconfigurations.
lessons.applies_when: When a feature flag deployment causes increased error rates in dependent services.

action_items: Review deployment and flag management processes for payment service.
Implement additional safeguards for feature flag changes to prevent similar incidents.
